title: Verse Capture: film a room (beta) | Verse Engine by Ctruh
description: Verse Capture: film a room in the Verse Engine by Ctruh docs: what it is, how to use it, and where it fits in your 3D workflow.

docs.article:
Film a room (beta)#

Film a room with your phone and get a walkable 3D space you can share as a link. A 30-second video typically comes back in two to three minutes.

How to film#

  1. Walk slowly around the edge. Start in a corner and move at half your normal pace, phone upright at chest height, about 2 metres from what you film.
  2. Film the walls, ceiling and floor. Tilt up to the ceiling and down to the floor now and then. Plain white walls and ceilings need to be seen to come out.
  3. 20 to 40 seconds, good light. Lights on, curtains open, one continuous shot. No zoom, no edits, nobody walking through.

The upload card shows these steps under Film a room, and checks your video's length and brightness before sending it.

Upload#

  • In the app: Film a room, then pick or drop the video (MP4, MOV, WebM or AVI), or a zip of 20 to 300 photos of the room.
  • On WhatsApp: send the video to the Verse number. Progress notes come back, then the link.

The scene opens at eye height facing the room, with a tour along the path you filmed.

If it did not work#

Verse checks the video before spending any time on it and says what to change.

MessageWhat to do
Too darkTurn the lights on and film again.
Too short or too few photosFilm 20 to 40 seconds, or send at least 20 photos.
Too blurryMove more slowly.
Could not work out the camera positionsFilm the whole room, overlapping the same areas again.
Could not find the floorTilt down so the floor is in the video.
Photo format not supported (HEIC)Export the photos as JPEG.
Capture is not availableThe service is off on this server; try again later.

After a successful capture you also get tips for the next one, such as filming the ceiling.

Good to know#

  • A capture is a Gaussian-splat scene, so it looks like the room, not like a clean model. It is best for showing a real place; for a designed home, use Floor plan to 3D home.
  • Rooms build one at a time; for a whole home, film each room.
  • Developers: see POST /v1/ingest in the API reference.
